008package createexperiment.app;
009
010import javax.swing.*;
011import java.awt.*;
012import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
013import java.io.File;
014import java.io.IOException;
015import java.nio.file.Path;
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.function.Function;
018import java.util.prefs.Preferences;
019import java.util.regex.Pattern;
020import java.util.regex.PatternSyntaxException;
021
022import static createexperiment.app.ExperimentInfoWriter.exportExperimentInfo;
023
024/**
025 * Fixed and visually balanced CreateExperimentUI.
026 * <p>
027 * Provides a complete Swing-based user interface for creating experiment configuration files.
028 * It allows users to select directories, filter image files by regular expression, and
029 * generate an "Experiment Info.csv" file.
030 * </p>
031 * <p>
032 * This class defines a graphical desktop tool that enables users to manage experiment setup
033 * through directory selection, regex-based filtering, and automated CSV generation. Regex
034 * history, directory paths, and UI state are stored in user preferences for convenience
035 * between sessions.
036 * </p>
037 * <ul>
038 *   <li>Persistent regex and directory preferences using java.util.prefs.</li>
039 *   <li>Interactive regex management (add, delete, apply filters).</li>
040 *   <li>Automatic refresh of visible file lists when input or filters change.</li>
041 *   <li>File processing workflow via ExperimentInfoWriter.</li>
042 *   <li>Cross-platform compatibility (macOS, Windows, Linux).</li>
043 * </ul>
044 */
045public class CreateExperimentUI {
046
047    private static final String PREF_NODE   = "paint/create-experiment";
048    private static final String KEY_IMAGES  = "lastImagesDir";
049    private static final String KEY_PROJECT = "lastProjectDir";
050
051    private static final String[] DEFAULT_REGEXES = {
052            "",
053            "^\\d-Exp-\\d+-[A-Z]\\d+-\\d+\\.nd2$",
054            "^(?!.*BF).*\\.nd2$"
055    };
056
057    /**
058     * The main method serves as the entry point for the application, initializing
059     * and displaying the Create Experiment GUI.
060     *
061     * @param args the command-line arguments passed to the application
062     */
063    public static void main(String[] args) {
064        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(CreateExperimentUI::createAndShowGUI);
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Configures and displays a graphical user interface (GUI) for managing regex filters,
069     * selecting input/output directories, and processing files. The GUI consists of multiple
070     * sections, including regex controls, file list display, input/output directory configurations,
071     * and action buttons. This method also uses preferences to remember user choices
072     * (e.g., regex history and last-used directories) and dynamically updates its components
073     * based on user actions.
074     * <p>
075     * Key Features:
076     * - Regex management: Users can add, select, and delete regex patterns.
077     * - Input/output directory selection: Users can specify directories for source files
078     * and output storage.
079     * - File display: Files in the selected input directory are listed and filtered based
080     * on the regex.
081     * - Persisted preferences: User choices (like regex patterns or directories) are saved
082     * and reloaded on subsequent application launches.
083     * - Modular panel layout: Organized interface using labeled sections for regex filtering,
084     * file selection, and processing actions.
085     * <p>
086     * Components:
087     * - Regex Controls: Dropdown allowing users to input regex patterns, supported by history and deletion menus.
088     * - File List: A dynamically updated list of files matching the selected regex in the input directory.
089     * - Input/Output Controls: Buttons and labels for selecting directories and displaying their current paths.
090     * - Action Buttons: Buttons for initiating the file processing operation and closing the application.
091     * <p>
092     * Dialogs:
093     * - Uses JFileChooser dialogs for selecting directories.
094     * <p>
095     * Event Handling:
096     * - Handles user interactions via buttons and combo box events (e.g., regex filtering, file refreshing).
097     * <p>
098     * Constraints:
099     * - Limits regex entry length to a maximum of 100 characters.
100     * - Ensures only valid directories are selected and persistently stores their paths.
101     * <p>
102     * Dependencies:
103     * - javax.swing (for GUI elements like JFrame, JPanel, JComboBox, JList, JButton).
104     * - java.util.prefs.Preferences (for storing user-specific persistent settings).
105     * - java.io.File (for directory and file handling).
106     * <p>
107     * Usage:
108     * Typically called during application initialization to present the user interface.
109     * This method does not return, as it focuses on creating and displaying the application
110     * window with active event handling for user interaction.
111     */
112    private static void createAndShowGUI() {
113        Preferences prefs = Preferences.userRoot().node(PREF_NODE);
114
115        JFrame frame = new JFrame("Create Experiment");
116        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
117
118        Font smallFont = new JLabel().getFont().deriveFont(Font.PLAIN, 12f);
119        int labelWidth = 100;
120        int buttonWidth = 90;
121        Dimension fieldSize = new Dimension(360, 24);
122        Dimension buttonSize = new Dimension(buttonWidth, 24);
123
124        // === Top panel (directories + regex) ===
125        JPanel top = new JPanel(new GridBagLayout());
126        top.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(10, 12, 5, 12));
127        GridBagConstraints gbc = new GridBagConstraints();
128        gbc.insets = new Insets(3, 3, 3, 3);
129        gbc.fill = GridBagConstraints.HORIZONTAL;
130
131        Function<String, JLabel> label = t -> {
132            JLabel l = new JLabel(t, SwingConstants.LEFT);
133            l.setFont(smallFont);
134            l.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(labelWidth, 24));
135            return l;
136        };
137
138        final File[] projectDir = {new File(prefs.get(KEY_PROJECT, System.getProperty("user.home")))};
139        final File[] imagesDir  = {new File(prefs.get(KEY_IMAGES, System.getProperty("user.home")))};
140
141        // --- Project Root ---
142        gbc.gridy = 0; gbc.gridx = 0;
143        top.add(label.apply("Project Root:"), gbc);
144        gbc.gridx = 1;
145        JTextField projectField = new JTextField(projectDir[0].getAbsolutePath());
146        projectField.setEditable(false);
147        projectField.setFont(smallFont);
148        projectField.setPreferredSize(fieldSize);
149        top.add(projectField, gbc);
150        gbc.gridx = 2;
151        JButton projectBrowse = new JButton("Browse…");
152        projectBrowse.setFont(smallFont);
153        projectBrowse.setPreferredSize(buttonSize);
154        top.add(projectBrowse, gbc);
155
156        // --- Images Root ---
157        gbc.gridy++;
158        gbc.gridx = 0;
159        top.add(label.apply("Images Root:"), gbc);
160        gbc.gridx = 1;
161        JTextField imagesField = new JTextField(imagesDir[0].getAbsolutePath());
162        imagesField.setEditable(false);
163        imagesField.setFont(smallFont);
164        imagesField.setPreferredSize(fieldSize);
165        top.add(imagesField, gbc);
166        gbc.gridx = 2;
167        JButton imagesBrowse = new JButton("Browse…");
168        imagesBrowse.setFont(smallFont);
169        imagesBrowse.setPreferredSize(buttonSize);
170        top.add(imagesBrowse, gbc);
171
172        // --- Regex ---
173        gbc.gridy++;
174        gbc.gridx = 0;
175        top.add(label.apply("Regex:"), gbc);
176        gbc.gridx = 1;
177        JComboBox<String> regexCombo = new JComboBox<>();
178        regexCombo.setEditable(true);
179        regexCombo.setFont(smallFont);
180        for (String def : DEFAULT_REGEXES) regexCombo.addItem(def);
181        top.add(regexCombo, gbc);
182        gbc.gridx = 2;
183        JButton filterButton = new JButton("Filter");
184        filterButton.setFont(smallFont);
185        filterButton.setPreferredSize(buttonSize);
186        top.add(filterButton, gbc);
187
188        // === File list ===
189        DefaultListModel<File> listModel = new DefaultListModel<>();
190        JList<File> fileList = new JList<>(listModel);
191        fileList.setFont(smallFont);
192        JScrollPane scroll = new JScrollPane(fileList);
193        scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(5, 12, 5, 12));
194
195        // === Bottom action bar ===
196        JPanel actions = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 8, 8));
197        JButton process = new JButton("Process");
198        JButton close = new JButton("Close");
199        process.setFont(smallFont);
200        close.setFont(smallFont);
201        process.setPreferredSize(buttonSize);
202        close.setPreferredSize(buttonSize);
203        actions.add(process);
204        actions.add(close);
205
206        frame.add(top, BorderLayout.NORTH);
207        frame.add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
208        frame.add(actions, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
209
210        // === Logic ===
211        Runnable refresh = () -> {
212            String regex = ((String) regexCombo.getEditor().getItem()).trim();
213            listModel.clear();
214            if (imagesDir[0] == null) return;
215            Pattern p = null;
216            if (!regex.isEmpty()) {
217                try { p = Pattern.compile(regex); }
218                catch (PatternSyntaxException ex) {
219                    JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(frame, "Invalid regex: " + ex.getDescription());
220                    return;
221                }
222            }
223            File[] files = imagesDir[0].listFiles(f -> f.isFile() && !f.isHidden());
224            if (files == null) return;
225            for (File f : files)
226                if (p == null || p.matcher(f.getName()).matches())
227                    listModel.addElement(f);
228        };
229
230        projectBrowse.addActionListener(e -> {
231            JFileChooser ch = new JFileChooser(projectDir[0]);
232            ch.setDialogTitle("Select Project Directory");
233            ch.setFileSelectionMode(JFileChooser.DIRECTORIES_ONLY);
234            ch.setAcceptAllFileFilterUsed(false); // ✅ hides "All files" filter
235            ch.setMultiSelectionEnabled(false);   // ✅ single directory only
236            if (ch.showOpenDialog(frame) == JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) {
237                projectDir[0] = ch.getSelectedFile();
238                projectField.setText(projectDir[0].getAbsolutePath());
239                prefs.put(KEY_PROJECT, projectDir[0].getAbsolutePath());
240            }
241        });
242
243        imagesBrowse.addActionListener(e -> {
244            JFileChooser ch = new JFileChooser(imagesDir[0]);
245            ch.setDialogTitle("Select Images Directory");
246            ch.setFileSelectionMode(JFileChooser.DIRECTORIES_ONLY);
247            ch.setAcceptAllFileFilterUsed(false);
248            ch.setMultiSelectionEnabled(false);
249            if (ch.showOpenDialog(frame) == JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) {
250                imagesDir[0] = ch.getSelectedFile();
251                imagesField.setText(imagesDir[0].getAbsolutePath());
252                prefs.put(KEY_IMAGES, imagesDir[0].getAbsolutePath());
253                refresh.run();
254            }
255        });
256
257        filterButton.addActionListener(e -> refresh.run());
258        regexCombo.addActionListener(e -> refresh.run());
259
260        process.addActionListener((ActionEvent e) -> {
261            if (projectDir[0] == null || imagesDir[0] == null) {
262                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(frame, "Select both Project and Images directories.");
263                return;
264            }
265            List<File> selected = fileList.getSelectedValuesList();
266            if (selected.isEmpty()) {
267                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(frame, "No files selected.");
268                return;
269            }
270            try {
271                String experimentName    = imagesDir[0].getName();
272                Path   experimentDirPath = projectDir[0].toPath().resolve(experimentName);
273
274                Path created = exportExperimentInfo(experimentDirPath, selected);
275                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(frame,
276                                              "Experiment info written to:\n" + created.toAbsolutePath(),
277                                              "Success", JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE);
278            } catch (IOException ex) {
279                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(frame, "Error: " + ex.getMessage());
280            }
281        });
282
283        close.addActionListener(e -> frame.dispose());
284
285        frame.setSize(560, 520);
286        frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
287        frame.setVisible(true);
288
289        refresh.run();
290    }
291}
